n.story:
Your role is shifting from a traditional laborer to a precision energy-efficiency technician. While the physical core of your job—cutting, fitting, and installing materials in tight, unpredictable spaces—remains firmly in human hands, the 'guesswork' of the trade is disappearing. AI-powered thermal imaging and computer vision now instantly identify heat leaks and moisture traps that were previously invisible, allowing you to target your efforts with surgical precision.

You no longer spend time manually deciphering complex 2D blueprints or cross-referencing material specs. Instead, you use AR glasses that overlay 3D installation plans directly onto the physical walls and suggest the optimal insulation materials based on real-time environmental data. Your value is no longer just in the 'install,' but in your ability to interpret AI-driven energy audits and ensure that the airtight construction meets the high-performance standards of modern, sustainable buildings.

You no longer spend time squinting at paper charts or manually inputting GPS coordinates; instead, your cabin is an augmented reality command center where AI overlays digital 3D plans onto your real-world view, highlighting potential hazards and structural constraints in real-time.
